security: All avatar image URLs are selected from a fixed local allowlist. SVGs contain static vector/text elements only, with no scripts, CSS, event handlers, links, images, animation, external resources or embedded payloads.
usage: Show a provider label beside each avatar. Preserve fallback kind in accessible text/tooltips. Keep the license and NOTICE files with redistributions. Never use these avatars as the app own logo.
